explanation: This test only verifies that the FX rate is locked at the moment of initiation (fx_lock). It does not test that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit), nor does it test the rollback behavior on timeout (timeout_rollback), nor the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval).
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught. Also, a bug where the transaction is not rolled back on provider callback timeout would be missed, as well as a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require second-owner approval.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify full top-up transaction behavior including FX lock, credit before debit, timeout rollback, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate used matches recorded FX rate
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Simulate provider callback timeout after 5 seconds
Verify transaction is rolled back and neither wallet nor funding source is affected
Verify that second business owner approval is required before settlement
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; transaction rolls back on provider callback timeout with no changes; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
